svg.title: CodeBuild-hosted GitHub Actions runners
svg.desc: A queued GitHub Actions job reaches CodeBuild through a repository or organization webhook; the runner project reads its GitHub token from its own secret, registers an ephemeral runner for the job, and writes build logs.
